message: 違うもの違わないもの

name: Helena
message: 「Phew... A twelve-year-old square bottle really has a mature flavor.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Lines like that only suit people who don't binge drink, you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「How rude. I just happen to hold my liquor well and drink a lot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Holding your liquor well or not, emptying four bottles in a single night is questionable at best. If you want to savor it, you should drink in moderation.」

name: Helena
message: 「And I suppose diluting yours with water and ice until it's practically clear is what makes you mature?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is my business. In the first place, I wasn't even drinking until you forced me to...」

name: Helena
message: 「I hear a handsome man was hitting on you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Cough, cough*」

name: Helena
message: 「So, what was your answer?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I turned him down, obviously.」

name: Helena
message: 「You turned him down this time too? How cold.」

name: Melilot
message: 「First of all, that man is an outsider. He isn't even a resident of Ryuusei Town. Since you are the board chairwoman, you ought to build a system to keep him out.」

name: Helena
message: 「Blocking one of the Seven Demon Generals from sneaking in is impossible with human science. Besides, if you put up a powerful barrier, our cover would be blown, wouldn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, that is true, but」

name: Helena
message: 「Do you really dislike him that much? Well, he does dress pretty young for his age. He really ought to go for a more rugged, mature look.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is simply your personal taste. To begin with, whether I dislike him or not isn't the issue. Having him show up during working hours is a nuisance.」

name: Helena
message: 「So outside of working hours would be fine, then?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It would not be fine.」

name: Helena
message: 「No chance at all, huh. Poor guy.」

name: Helena
message: 「Come to think of it, he had a cell phone, didn't he?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, before anyone realized it.」

name: Helena
message: 「You at least gave him your email address, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I did not!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was forced to teach them, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「You should've just taught them」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'd hate it if I started getting emails every thirty minutes」

name: Helena
message: 「Can you even type emails?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I can! You know I can!」

name: Helena
message: 「I meant that person」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah... yes, they were typing away rapidly while talking to me. They were remarkably fast, I must say」

name: Helena
message: 「They've completely adapted to this world, haven't they」

name: Melilot
message: 「Judging by the fact that their magic hasn't degraded, it seems they return to the Demon World frequently」

name: Helena
message: 「I wonder how they're making money?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Who knows... They're probably smuggling goods from the Demon World into the Human World or something」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, Melilot」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is it?」

name: Helena
message: 「You think this is delicious too, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, well... as long as the portion isn't too big」

name: Helena
message: 「We're different races, yet our sense of taste is practically the same」

name: Melilot
message: 「...What are you trying to say?」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm saying we're surprisingly alike」

name: Helena
message: 「Sure, we're different races. Even so, you and I were able to become friends, weren't we?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...That is true」

name: Helena
message: 「Flirting with someone, being flirted with. Demons are just like humans. Why can't people understand something so simple?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Race is surely not what matters. As proof of that, even humans fail to understand one another, do they not?」

name: Helena
message: 「There are plenty of people who do understand each other」

name: Helena
message: 「In fact, here you and I are, sitting at the same table, aren't we?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you drunk?」

name: Helena
message: 「A little. But isn't it fine to dream every once in a while?」
Melilot picked up the glass and downed the impossibly watered-down whiskey in one gulp.

name: Melilot
message: 「Understanding each other is the exception. Besides, we don't have the time.」
